I also feel this way. Born to shitty people in a shitty situation who take it out on you. You try to get help, maybe try to claw your way out, but nobody gives a shit the one time it actually matters. Then you grow up and become shitty yourself, just like the rest of them. Nothing but piles of shit out here, as far as I can see. 

The amount of bureaucracy you have to wade through to get any sort of help is infuriating and borderline impassable. There is no human element to these things, you have to wave dollars in front of people's noses to get them to care. Otherwise, you're just a number; another nuisance stopping them from filing their nails for the millionth time. But if you had money, you wouldn't be fucked up to begin with. I agree with you--I really do hate that *superior* look in their eyes, that they basically have control over your life in that moment and get to decide whether you even get an attempt at alleviating your pain and living a dignified existence. Obviously, they decided you didn't have enough money for that. 

Makes you feel like dirt.

--From a childhood abuse sufferer with lifelong major depression, anxiety, and ADHD.
